title: Hourly WEF-Columbus Auto-Dig:AndHealth incentive and location pass
summary: Dataset-first hourly pass selecting the queued AndHealth incentive-ledger target; adds conservative current location semantics, confirms the latest known City incentive payment surface, and records a current-news search with no filler event.

data.research_question: What current defensible location can be attached to AndHealth, and what primary records advance the queued AndHealth public-assistance and incentive-ledger target?
data.method: Enumerated 27 physical dig roots on current main. Excluded free-range as meta plus hunter-biden, gop, and dnc as the previous three successful hourly roots, leaving 23 eligible roots. Dataset seed 6750929699392883503 selected wef-columbus uniformly at dataset stage. The selected dataset exposed eight queued depth-6 targets in the latest completed WEF-Columbus pass. Target seed 7215417881434036756 selected starintel:investigation-target:wef-depth-6-andhealth-incentive-ledger. HQ/location review used current first-party AndHealth contact/legal surfaces, the City of Columbus 2022 headquarters-operations ordinance, and the current LinkedIn company profile. The incentive slice rechecked Columbus Ordinance 1885-2025. Current-news review searched AndHealth's current news surface and broader August 2026 results; no material new AndHealth event was found, so none was invented.
classification_rules: dataset-first uniform selection after previous-three exclusions
current contact address is not automatically current headquarters
historical headquarters operations do not silently become a current street-HQ claim
headquarters locality may be recorded separately when explicitly labeled

findings.finding: AndHealth currently publishes 2 Miranova Pl, Columbus, Ohio 43215 as its organizational contact address; first-party legal/privacy surfaces specify Suite 500.
A 2022 City of Columbus ordinance explicitly described the Miranova project as establishing and expanding AndHealth headquarters operations at that site.

AndHealth's current LinkedIn profile labels Columbus, Ohio as headquarters and 2 Miranova Pl as its primary location, but the reviewed current first-party page does not explicitly label the street as headquarters.
Columbus Ordinance 1885-2025 authorized a $47,727.97 Downtown Office Incentive payment to AndHealth for tax year 2024 and identified 2024 as its first report year.
The reviewed current AndHealth news index exposed no material August 2026 development; no filler news event was created.
